data.cultural_impact: The name Charisse has been popular in the English-speaking world since the Middle Ages. Its Greek origin and association with the idea of grace make it a desirable name for girls in many cultures. Additionally, due to its similarity to the name "Cary" and "Carrie," it has also been used in the entertainment industry, including ladies such as Charisse constable (actress) and Charisse Mills (model).
data.spiritual_significance: Charisse embodies the Christian virtue of grace. In the Christian faith, grace is an unmerited favor from God. It is the divine help that God gives to His people. By naming a girl Charisse, parents can instill in her the reminder of God's unending grace and to strive to extend that same grace to others. Additionally, the name Charisse can serve as a reminder to live a life filled with kindness, generosity, and goodwill, all of which are manifestations of God's grace.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Charisse was a popular name among French nobility during the 15th century. The name Charisse carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

trends: an increasing popularity among African Americans in the mid-20th century
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Charisse remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named Ruth Charisse in Jerusalem, Israel credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Charisse, which means "Graceful, charming". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.

data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Charisse is derived from the Greek word "charis," meaning grace or kindness. In Christian belief, this name symbolizes the divine grace bestowed upon individuals, inspiring them to show love, compassion, and generosity to others.
